artworks.title: sequence 2a
artworks.alt: Expressionist portrait head in acrylic and marker, dark hair against an orange aura

artworks.title: sequence 2b
artworks.medium: White and Transparent filament suspended to create shadow with light
artworks.alt: Line drawing of a face in transparent 3D-pen filament suspended over paper paired with sequence 2a

artworks.title: sequence 2c
artworks.medium: White and transparent filament with projected shadow
artworks.alt: Transparent filament portrait suspended above paper so the sculpted line and its projected shadow form two faces
artworks.statement: This filament construction is the three-dimensional counterpart to The Watchman, which appears in Witnesses. Here, light separates the object from the projected portrait it produces.

artworks.title: sequence 1a
artworks.medium: acrylic on paper and 3D hand printed filament
artworks.image: /assets/uploads/My face filament on top of the watcher.jpg
artworks.alt: Expressionist portrait head in acrylic and marker, with hand printed 3D filament

artworks.title: sequence-1b
artworks.alt: Line drawing of a face in white and transparent 3D-pen filament suspended over paper with shadow creating the 3rd image

artworks.title: sequence 1c
artworks.medium: hand printed 3d filament suspended on top of wood
artworks.alt: Transparent filament portrait suspended above wood panel

artworks.title: sequence 4a
artworks.alt: Elongated mixed-media portrait with wide black eyes and softly washed peach, gray, and rose passages

artworks.title: sequence 4b
artworks.alt: Black filament translation of an elongated face built across a translucent rectangular support

artworks.title: sequence 5
artworks.medium: Mixed media and filament on paper
artworks.alt: Black and white filament portrait aligned over a pink and orange painted face

artworks.title: sequence 6
artworks.medium: Paint marker and mixed media on translucent paper
artworks.alt: Backlit translucent-paper portrait whose pale face changes to slate blue as a hand and its shadow enter the image
artworks.statement: A single face changes register as light passes through the sheet. In the backlit view, pale marks collapse into a slate-blue mass while the hand and its shadow enter the portrait as temporary structure.

artworks.title: Divided Light
artworks.alt: Frontal portrait divided into warm orange and cool blue planes against a blue ground

artworks.title: Green Room
artworks.alt: Asymmetrical portrait with a dark sculpted hairstyle against a turquoise green ground

artworks.title: Inward Bloom
artworks.alt: Vivid symmetrical face built from eyes, lips, leaves, and curling fluorescent lines

artworks.title: Inversion Study
artworks.alt: Orange, cyan, violet, and white expressionist portrait photographed on a wood floor

artworks.title: Inversion Study II
artworks.alt: Mauve and blue mask-like portrait with orange contours and doubled facial features

artworks.title: Inversion Study III
artworks.alt: Orange, cream, and charcoal portrait in which eyes, mouth, and surrounding fields exchange positions

artworks.title: Inversion Study IV
artworks.alt: Split pink and cream portrait surrounded by a black circular field with blue and magenta corners
artworks.statement: Rotation reorganizes the face around a black circular field. The split coloring and doubled directional pull make orientation part of the portrait rather than a correction applied to it.

artworks.title: Red Mask
artworks.alt: Angular red portrait mask with black recessed eyes against an orange ground

artworks.title: Red Witness
artworks.alt: Close expressionist portrait in red, black, orange, and pink with a dark sweep surrounding the face
artworks.statement: A close, compressed face holds the viewer inside a dark sweep of hair and red ground. Exposed lines remain visible across the features, keeping the image unsettled rather than resolved.

artworks.title: Electric Witness
artworks.alt: Brightly colored expressionist profile with wide eyes and green upright hair

artworks.title: The Watchman
artworks.alt: Linear portrait of a bald, bearded man with an elaborate moustache and green eyes

artworks.title: Messenger
artworks.alt: Pale frontal portrait marked with fine yellow and violet lines and a small bird at the shoulder

artworks.title: Soft Field I
artworks.alt: Soft red, peach, turquoise, and gray color field punctuated by small raised marks

artworks.title: Soft Field II
artworks.medium: Acrylic and mixed media on canvas
artworks.alt: Dark central figure emerging from overlapping red, orange, and pink circular fields above a pale blue garment
artworks.statement: A figure emerges from overlapping red and orange forms, with the surrounding field behaving as aura, hair, atmosphere, and pressure at once.
